weight_attribution.purpose: Per-(row, channel) imaging weights of an evidence-only instrumented build (never committed) against CASA's IMAGING_WEIGHT table, captured by wrapping PySynthesisImager.makePSF: field 0 of refim_alma_mosaic.ms as a uniform mosweight cube at the middle field's centre, 7.5 arcsec away, first in casa-rs's frames, then gridding the density at GridFT's rotation of the MeasurementSet uvw and looking it up at the MeasurementSet uvw, as BriggsCubeWeightor does.
weight_attribution.note: worst is the largest relative difference; inf marks a sample CASA weighs zero and casa-rs does not. The test_ephemeris case was imaged by the binary before the cubesource refusal (dcfada3), which refuses it in tclean, naming #980.
